commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3d3a38885fb458d7693eab39450dad8506d504f6
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
ROOT=managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include

echo '=== FULL EZB IAS ZONE HEADER ==='
cat "$ROOT/ezbee/zcl/cluster/ias_zone.h"

echo '=== FULL EZB IAS ZONE DESC HEADER ==='
cat "$ROOT/ezbee/zcl/cluster/ias_zone_desc.h"

echo '=== COMPAT IAS HEADER RELEVANT 75-220 ==='
sed -n '75,220p' "$ROOT/compat/zcl/esp_zigbee_zcl_ias_zone.h"

echo '=== ALL STATUS CHANGE SYMBOLS WITH FILE+LINE ==='
grep -RniE 'status[_ ]change|STATUS_CHANGE|zone_status|ZONE_STATUS' "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'ias|zone' | head -300

echo '=== ALL IAS EXPORTED DECLARATIONS ==='
grep -RniE '^[[:space:]]*(esp_err_t|esp_zb_zcl_status_t|ezb_zcl_status_t|bool|void|uint[0-9]+_t)[[:space:]*]+(esp_zb|ezb)_[A-Za-z0-9_]*(ias|zone)[A-Za-z0-9_]*[[:space:]]*\(' "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null | head -300 || true

echo '=== COMMAND API HEADERS CONTAINING IAS ==='
for H in $(grep -RIlE 'IAS_ZONE|ias_zone' "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'command|cmd|zcl_command|zcl_common|ias_zone' | sort -u); do
  echo --- $H
  grep -nE -B12 -A35 'IAS_ZONE|ias_zone|status_change|STATUS_CHANGE' "$H" | head -260 || true
done

echo '=== EMULATOR PROFILE CONFIG / JOIN CALLBACK CONTEXT ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/main/emulator_main.c')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
for needle in ['add_ias_contact_endpoint', 'initialize_ias_contact_attributes', 'network steering status', 'ESP_ZB_BDB_SIGNAL_STEERING', 'set_server_attr']:
    print('###',needle)
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if needle.lower() in l.lower():
            for n in range(max(0,i-35),min(len(lines),i+100)): print(f'{n+1:5d}: {lines[n]}')
            print()
PY
